In Lektion 2 bist du dem ID-Faden von Ha: In lesson 2 you followed the ID thread by hand: from the number in one table to the matching row in the other. JOIN does exactly that for you – for all rows at once. That way you get song titles and artist names in one list, although they are in two tables. Almost every app does this all the time.
